title: POLAR: A Benchmark for Multilingual, Multicultural, and Multi-Event Online Polarization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned multilingual language models and zero-/few-shot large language models on a multi-label text classification task to detect political or ideological polarization and its manifestations (e.g., stereotyping, vilification) in multilingual social media posts.

Evaluating fine-tuned multilingual language models and zero-/few-shot large language models on a multi-label text classification task to detect racial or ethnic polarization and its manifestations in multilingual social media posts.

Evaluating fine-tuned multilingual language models and zero-/few-shot large language models on a multi-label text classification task to detect religious polarization and its manifestations in multilingual social media posts.

Evaluating fine-tuned multilingual language models and zero-/few-shot large language models on a multi-label text classification task to detect gender-based polarization and its manifestations in multilingual social media posts.

Evaluating fine-tuned multilingual language models and zero-/few-shot large language models on a multi-label text classification task to detect sexual orientation-based polarization and its manifestations in multilingual social media posts.
